eligible_definition: Every fixed hard presentation and consensus pair is correct in all layers in three predeclared runs; all required runs complete and technically valid; original99/reviewed99/strict97 directional means each meet the fixed baseline. Personal reference target is evaluated separately.
best_metric_rank: final personal120 directional mean exact fraction
final personal120 pair mean exact fraction
final_selection_rank: three-run hard technical validity and zero raw wrong-allow directions at every layer
total correct hard-presentation directions across every layer in the same three repeats
incomplete_evidence: Provisional only. Missing/failed judgments receive zero credit within fixed required denominators and remain visible; do not replace failed run identities.
hard_correctness_mandatory: Averages or final rescues never convert a failed main/coverage presentation into hard PASS.
locked_target: A confirmed target or accepted version is retained immutably even if later versions fail.
comparability: No cross-version, cross-prompt or cross-run best-result splicing.
